description: Read a whole tender package with Cohere Command A+ and explain it to a business owner: what it is, who can bid, how offers are evaluated, everything that must be submitted (with document and page), fit, risks and next actions. Reads the notice and every published CanadaBuys attachment, amendments first. Alberta APC: the first call returns a private upload link (APC releases documents only to the user's own supplier account); call again with upload_token. The tender text is sent to Cohere. The model reasons before answering, so a call can take several minutes; a reply cut off by max_tokens returns an error, never a partial analysis. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required. Hosted: sign-in and an active workspaceAlberta Pro subscription required.

business_context.description: Optional company capabilities or bid context. If omitted, the saved business profile is used.

max_tokens.description: Tokens for reasoning plus the answer (default 50000, min 4000, max 64000)

profile.description: Inline business profile used for this call only. Overrides any saved profile. On the shared public endpoint without a subscriber key, this is the way to describe your business.

capabilities.description: Optional explicit capability keywords; derived from description when omitted

description.description: What the business does: products, services, capabilities

industries.description: Optional sector labels for any business. Steel, lumber, aluminum, and construction still work. So do software, healthcare, energy, mining, training, or your own wording. Labels rank matches. They do not hide other contracts.

location.description: Where the business is located, e.g. 'Edmonton, Alberta'

question.description: Optional specific question to ask about the tender

reference.description: Reference or solicitation number for the tender to analyze

upload_token.description: For APC only: the upload_token from an earlier classify_tender, process_bid_room or analyze_contract_with_cohere result, after the user uploaded the documents.

name: analyze_contract_with_cohere
title: Analyze a contract with Cohere
